scope: Compile fixed gate_group serial execution deadlines in the existing CI graph owner before workflow allocation
contract: Every fixed gate_group executes its declared gates serially; sum every declared gate body timeout and each gate interpreter probe plus two cleanup allowances, then add existing graph headroom once and quantize upward to provider minutes.
Validate every sibling consumer independently using the existing canonical gate deadline policy; per-gate overrides and legacy absence defaults remain applicable.

A job whose available deadline is below this derived bound rejects before rendering or dependent allocation; this slice uses the existing declared executor gate population. Independent discovery of omitted execution effects remains foundation.conformance work.
The unchanged gate_shard static maximum remains a per-gate floor only; complete actual session assignment, retry, API read, environment setup and cleanup containment remain separately open.
Existing component minimum_job_timeout_minutes remain lower-bound floors and are not additive body durations. No performance targets or timeout policy values are invented.
Canonical private mirrors are generated through the existing pack generator. No hand-edited workflows, authority pins, predecessor bytes, adopter trees or other-agent execution owners.

The existing reference graph builder derives conservative serial-group outer defaults from the same legacy gate bounds and existing300s reference headroom. Actual repository policy is still validated; a larger override can require an explicit policy repair. Preserve larger authored defaults and provider deadline caps.
verification: Serial sum rejects a group whose largest individual gate fits but complete sequence does not.
Exact quantized boundary passes; one minute below rejects; every per-gate setup and cleanup allowance is included.
Overrides, singleton groups, sibling groups and legacy policy absence remain covered.
Separate shard floor and component minimum semantics retain existing behavior.
Restore the previous maximum-only guard and observe cause-specific serial-population failures.
Affected graph, architecture, governed checks and private mirror parity must pass before integration.
Generated standard/lite and scheduled serial groups contain legacy policy totals; existing v3 shard topology remains unchanged.
limits: This slice does not close whole runtime deadline composition, actual shard admission or independent P32 verification.
